title: Stall warning ignores a worker waiting on its own background work, and lost background notices
notes: Night of 2026-11-28: every worker was flagged 'no sign of life for 20 minutes' while its review loop ran as a background workflow (pane list said running, report said 'the loop is running in the background'): a false alarm each time, four at once. Separately, four workers sat for an hour 'waiting' on background checks and a push that had already finished (check.log written, no process left); the harness notice never reached them, under load ~90 on 16 cores. Wanted: the stall rule (stall.ts, workers-decision-13) treats a worker with live background work as waiting, not stalled; and a stall whose background work is gone says so, e.g. 'its background task ended N minutes ago and it has not resumed', so main can nudge it. Not shipped: for the user to decide in the morning.
